open_points.subject: startup recovery after an unknown outcome was resolved not_applied
open_points.text: “an attempt the owner resolved concludes from its records and is not reached again” conflicts with A11 rule 3, which says a resolved `not_applied` element is reached again to request the fresh approval required for its next attempt
open_points.question: During startup recovery, what happens when `not_applied` was committed but the fresh approval request was not written before the process stopped?
options: Reach the element through `effects.reach_operation_element` and create the fresh approval request
Derive an `owner_approval` waiting point without creating an EffectApproval
Leave the run pending until another operation explicitly reaches the element
open_points.default_guess: Reach the element only when it was resolved `not_applied` and no fresh requested approval already exists; resolved `applied` attempts are not reached again.

open_points.subject: bindings.check_installed_instances startup manifest validation
open_points.text: “a manifest record that cannot be read or fails a check of the record itself (A08 rule 5) stops the start naming it” invokes A08 rule 5 without an operation name or proposed ports, although many of that rule’s checks are operation- and proposal-specific
open_points.question: Which manifest checks does `bindings.check_installed_instances` perform at startup, over which capability entries, and in what order?
options: Check only the service-record and selected-instance facts needed to detect credential-header collisions
Validate every capability entry, in a specified capability order
Check only that the manifest record can be read and parsed, deferring all capability checks to proposal and send
open_points.default_guess: Check only readable service-record structure and the selected instance’s required headers needed for the credential-header collision check; defer operation-specific checks to proposal, acceptance and send.
